Thanks for tuning in to our podcast show, Food Advice.
In this week's episode, we're discussing an ordinary topic, grocery shopping.
One of the tips we'll share is how to make a shopping list.
It's important to make a list, since it can save you a lot of time and money at the store.
However, before we begin, I'd like to remind you about our upcoming raffle contest where we'll be giving away gift cards to several people. lucky listeners.
All you have to do to enter is post a review of this episode to our podcast social media site.

我们将分享的技巧之一是如何制定一份购物清单。
列清单很重要，因为它可以为您在商店节省大量的时间和金钱。
然而，在我们开始之前，我想提醒大家关于即将举行的抽奖活动，届时我们将向几位幸运听众赠送礼品卡。
您只需在本播客的社交媒体网站上发布本集评论即可参与。
